name: figma-diagrams
description: Work with Figma and FigJam files via the Figma REST API — read existing file structure, list frames/pages, post comments, and produce FigJam-importable diagram specs. Use when the user mentions a Figma URL, asks to inspect/audit a Figma file, wants to comment on a design programmatically, or wants their architecture diagram in Figma.

permissions.notes: Reads FIGMA_TOKEN from the environment to call the Figma REST API. Its instructions install the pinned requirements once with `python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt`, which reaches PyPI.

model.rationale: Measured (RFC-0073): on its held-out evals the light tier met 92% and 92% of checks in two tier trials, against standard's 92% and heavy's 75% and 92%, within 5 points of the best both times.
